_hinweis: Figurenblatt und Stil für den Comic-Pilot. Aussehen nach Bildlexikon (Pflichtmerkmale), ergänzt um Alter und Unterscheidungsmerkmale, die in der ChatGPT-Vorlage fehlten (Maria zu jung, Rollen mit gleichen Stirnbändern, Tonkrüge statt Steinkrüge). KI-Entwurf (Claude) vom 2026-10-27.
stil: Reduced watercolour comic for adults ("Stil 4"): loose, warm watercolour washes over confident fine ink lines, soft muted earth palette with sky blue, terracotta and olive accents, generous white paper around the panels, minimalist backgrounds with silhouetted crowds, expressive yet calm faces, accurate proportions and convincing perspective, artistic and grown-up, never cartoonish or cute.

figuren.FIG-JESUS: Jesus: a Galilean man of about thirty, shoulder-length dark brown hair, short full beard, warm brown eyes, a real human face shown openly like everyone else's; cream-white tunic and a deep red mantle over one shoulder. He is the only person on the page wearing red.
figuren.FIG-MARIA-MUTTER-JESU: Mary, the mother of Jesus: a woman of about fifty, clearly a generation older than her son, a few lines around the eyes, a little grey at the temples; blue veil over a blue robe.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-JUENGER: The disciples: four or five young men in earth-coloured brown and ochre robes with belts, no headbands, staying close to Jesus.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-DIENER: The servants: men and women of different ages in plain sand-beige tunics with belts and pale linen aprons, sleeves rolled up, bare-headed.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-SPEISEMEISTER: The master of the feast: a portly older man with a grey beard and receding grey hair, bare-headed, in a dark green robe with a wide golden belt, holding an earthenware cup.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-BRAEUTIGAM: The bridegroom: a young man in a violet festive robe with a wreath of fresh flowers on his head.
figuren.FIG-ROLLE-HAENDLER: Money changers and dove sellers: bearded men with striped headbands at tables and cages, ordinary dignified people, no caricature.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-FRAGENDE: The questioners ("the Jews" in John's wording): temple authorities and worshippers of varied ages in grey, blue and white robes and prayer shawls, dignified and serious, never caricatured.
figuren.FIG-GRUPPE-MENGE: Pilgrims in Jerusalem at Passover: a varied crowd of men, women and children in everyday robes.

regeln: The six water jars are large carved STONE jars, waist-high and very heavy, each holding about a hundred litres; servants fill them from smaller clay pitchers. Cups are simple earthenware. Light comes from daylight or small clay oil lamps. Jesus appears in every panel where the text has him present, and in the closing panel of Cana he stands with his disciples.
